title: triggers
description: manage your global triggers to be used on rules or external triggers

info.title: What is a Trigger?
info.description: A Trigger is how MapexOS reaches the outside world — the single egress point where an event becomes a real action against an external system: an HTTP webhook, an MQTT publish, an email, or a Slack message. It is the only place the platform performs outbound I/O.

egress.title: Single Egress Point
egress.text: Every outbound action — HTTP, MQTT, email, chat — leaves through one place, so integrations stay consistent and observable

connectors.title: 8 Connectors, One Port
connectors.text: HTTP, MQTT, NATS, email, Slack, Teams and more, each a pluggable executor — a new integration is a new connector, not a new service

fired.title: Fired by Rules or Workflows
fired.text: The Router fires a trigger when a match rule passes (event → action), or a workflow node hands over a resolved action and waits for the result

stored.title: Stored or On-the-Fly
stored.text: Reuse a stored, configured trigger by id, or run a fully-resolved action handed over on the wire — the path that powers plugins
